variants.text: You lift a huge delivery box, but it's so light you nearly fling it over your head. Ease off and give it a puzzled shake.
performanceSteps: Lift a huge delivery box
Ease off as the light box flies up, then shake it curiously.

variants.text: You try to lift a huge delivery box, but it's far too heavy. Adjust your grip several times, then set it down and rub your arms.
performanceSteps: Lift a huge delivery box
Try different grips on the heavy box, then set it down and rub your arms.

variants.text: You pull a blanket over yourself, but there's a huge amount left over. Roll up the extra fabric into a bigger and bigger bundle.
performanceSteps: Pull a blanket over yourself
Roll the extra-long blanket into an enormous bundle.

variants.text: You pull a blanket over yourself, but it's too short. Tug it between your shoulders and knees, then curl into a tiny ball.
performanceSteps: Pull a blanket over yourself
Try to cover your shoulders and knees, then curl up under the tiny blanket.

variants.text: You zip up your jacket, but the zipper keeps sliding back down. Hold the bottom and carefully guard it as you pull it up.
performanceSteps: Zip up your jacket
Hold the bottom of the slipping zipper and carefully pull it up.

variants.text: You zip up your jacket, but the zipper jams halfway. Tug it gently back and forth, then look down to inspect the snag.
performanceSteps: Zip up your jacket
Tug the jammed zipper back and forth, then inspect it closely.

variants.text: You squeeze toothpaste onto a toothbrush, but it keeps coming out like a long rope. Let go quickly and try to coil up the excess.
performanceSteps: Squeeze toothpaste onto a toothbrush
Let go of the tube and coil up the endless toothpaste.

variants.text: You squeeze toothpaste onto a toothbrush, but the tube is almost empty. Roll it up from the bottom and squeeze out one last tiny dab.
performanceSteps: Squeeze toothpaste onto a toothbrush
Roll up the nearly empty tube and squeeze out the last dab.

variants.text: You water a potted plant, but the stream bends its leaves right over. Stop pouring and gently lift the leaves back up.
performanceSteps: Water a potted plant
Stop watering and gently support the bent leaves.

variants.text: You water a potted plant, but all the water runs toward you. Pull your hands back, dodge the stream, and inspect the pot.
performanceSteps: Water a potted plant
Pull back from the water and inspect the leaking pot.

variants.text: You switch on a desk lamp, but it's blindingly bright. Shield your eyes and carefully turn the lamp away.
performanceSteps: Switch on a desk lamp
Shield your eyes and turn the dazzling lamp away.

variants.text: You switch on a desk lamp, but it's barely glowing. Squint, lean closer, and adjust the lamp to find a little light.
performanceSteps: Switch on a desk lamp
Squint and lean closer, adjusting the dim lamp.
